name: Astro Landing Page
description: A responsive Astro landing page with an automated GitHub Pages deployment.

variables.name: githubOwner
variables.description: The GitHub user or organization that owns the repository.

variables.name: repositoryName
variables.description: The GitHub repository name used to calculate the Pages base path.

commands.verify: npm run check && npm run build

postCreatePrompt: Replace the Northstar sample brand and content with the user's product, preserve the responsive and accessible layout, run npm run build, and confirm the GitHub Pages repository settings use GitHub Actions as the source.
